name: 별의 계승
effect: Consume the existing next-hit kill reward on a fresh marked foe. If the ordinary direct attack deals positive damage and the foe survives, start at2stars rather than1.
cost: No additional MP/piety/action/star cost. Original attack/spell cost applies.
constraints: One-shot and reward-only kills give no inherited stars or recursive reward.
An already stacked target gains the normal1 only, max3.
Divine powers and DoT/pet damage do not trigger inheritance.
save: Banked reward already uses saved offence/three_end fields; inheritance flag is per-action only. Native bank-save, actual next spell outcomes and strict ordinary-combat RNG continuation verified. Full post-targeting-UI RNG equality is logged separately.
